blockingChecks: Selected delivery profile is fully implemented; metadata alone does not count.
No content block collision, title/visual overlap, or safe-margin violation.
No horizontal or vertical clipping at canonical 16:9 and common laptop viewport.
Editable-deck supports text, layout, theme/style, media insertion, undo/redo, save, reload, and present-current-slide.
Presenter mode works by keyboard and touch and contains no editor chrome.
Shortcut help is visible, accessible, and available in editor and presenter contexts.
All interactive controls are keyboard reachable with visible focus.
No untrusted raw HTML or unsanitized SVG is rendered.
Every image, diagram, chart, and video has an accessible text alternative.
No placeholder content, fake metrics, invented citations, logos, screenshots, or testimonials remain.
Typecheck, tests, layout audit, output-contract validation, and production build pass.

checks: Semantic slot layout is used by default
Controls mutate DeckProject and update canvas
Shortcut help and command discovery are visible

aiSlopDetectors: More than two gradients on one slide
Glassmorphism used as default container style
Decorative glowing orbs behind unrelated content
Dark neon AI aesthetic selected without domain rationale
Generic titles such as Overview, Solution, Benefits without a claim
Charts without units, source, or takeaway
Large unused regions caused by weak composition
Absolute-positioned content crossing semantic layout boundaries
Toolbar visuals without functional editor behavior
